response.sql: WITH race_name_averages AS (SELECT r.name AS race_name, AVG(ds.points) AS average_points FROM races AS r JOIN driverStandings AS ds ON ds.raceId = r.raceId WHERE ds.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r.name), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(average_points) AS average_points FROM race_name_averages) SELECT rna.race_name, rna.average_points, rna.average_points - oa.average_points AS difference FROM race_name_averages AS rna CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa WHERE rna.average_points > oa.average_points
